steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. For voltage checks on powered circuits, use appropriate PPE and one-hand test technique.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug the appliance before replacing or repairing electrical parts.

steps.title: Ice maker error history
steps.body: Freezer ice maker error displays after 3 failures. Inspect fill tube, harness, and module installation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Freezer ice maker error displays after 3 failures. Inspect fill tube, harness, and module installation.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ice maker module and verify harvest.

steps.title: Verify ice maker operation
steps.body: After replacement, confirm harvest cycle and fill complete without repeating error.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After replacement, confirm harvest cycle and fill complete without repeating error.

steps.title: Replace ice maker
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ice maker module when function error persists.

steps.title: Ice maker OK
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker function verified after service.
